svg.title: Fogcast baseline A architecture: observation and forecast fusion in a residual U-Net
svg.desc: Tensors use batch, channel, height, width order. The five-channel fine input at 400 by 400 combines current GOES B2-derived clear score and validity, land fraction, elevation and current solar cosine. Encoder 0 produces 16 channels at 400 by 400, encoder 1 produces 32 channels at 200 by 200, and encoder 2 produces 32 channels at 100 by 100. At this two-kilometre level, concatenate 25 conditioning channels: current GOES CSM clear class and validity, eleven NBM sky-cover forecasts valid from issuance through ten hours ahead, ten future solar cosines, and two seasonal sine/cosine fields. Fusion maps the resulting 57 channels to 64. Skip 2 branches after this fusion. Encoder 3 produces 128 channels at 50 by 50; the bottleneck produces 256 at 25 by 25. Each decoder step first bilinearly resizes by two, then concatenates the corresponding encoder skip, then applies a residual block. Decoder 3 receives 384 channels and returns 128 at 50 by 50; decoder 2 receives 192 and returns 64 at 100 by 100; decoder 1 receives 96 and returns 32 at 200 by 200; decoder 0 receives 48 and returns 16 at 400 by 400. A one-by-one convolution gives ten logits; sigmoid gives ten hourly clear-sky probability maps at 500 metres for one through ten hours ahead, all in one forward pass.
svg.text: Baseline Model A · Residual 2D U-Net · ten forecast hours in one forward pass

g.text: Valid at t, t+1, …, t+10 h

svg.text: Encoder / decoder blocks are residual. Decoder concatenation follows bilinear upsampling.
Tensor order: [B, C, H, W] · t = forecast issuance · solar cosine = cos(solar zenith) · 0 = cloudy, 1 = clear
